programs.name: Two-Year Post Graduate Programme in Management (MBA-PGP)
programs.feeNote: Programme fee stated for the PGP 2025-27 batch (inclusive of tuition fee INR 20,10,000); excludes boarding, laptop, travel and personal expenses. IIMA says the fee for future batches will be announced later.

feeSource.title: IIMA Admission Policy (Domestic) - MBA/PGP admissions page (fee statement for PGP 2025-27 batch; text as captured by Internet Archive on 2026-07-16 at http://web.archive.org/web/20260716134732/https://www.iima.ac.in/academics/mba/admissions/indians)
feeSource.quote: The programme fee is INR 27,50,000/- for the PGP 2025-27 Batch (inclusive of tuition fees of INR 20,10,000/-). The programme fee does not cover personal expenses on boarding, laptop computer, travel, clothes, stationery, laundry, etc. ... The programme fee for future batches will be announced later.

programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2025 sanctioned intake (academic year 2023-24) for all 2-year PG programmes of the institute combined, not only this programme.

intakeSource.title: NIRF India Rankings 2025 - Data submitted by institution (Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad) [IR-M-S-8890]
intakeSource.quote: Sanctioned (Approved) Intake ... Academic Year 2023-24 2022-23 ... PG [2 Year Program(s)] 455 444

programs.salaryNote: Median 'Maximum Earning Potential' for the MBA-PGP Class of 2026 (392 students), from the IPRS-audited final placement report.

salarySource.title: IIMA MBA Placement Report - Finals 2026 (IPRS audited by B2K Analytics)
salarySource.quote: 5.4 Combined Salary Statistics in INR ... Maximum Earning Potential | 12,00,000 | 2,31,03,000 | 37,97,495 | 37,00,000 | 392 (Min | Max | Mean | Median | Data)

cutoffs.notes: Sectional minimum applies to each of VARC, DILR and QA. IIMA applies these cut-offs after computing a normalized composite score (CAT total percentile 65%, application rating 35%); bachelor's degree with at least 50% (45% for SC/ST/PwD) required.
